raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: Incorrectly stated that aldosterone (the sodium-retaining hormone) is produced by the zona fasciculata of the adrenal cortex; in fact, aldosterone is a mineralocorticoid produced by the zona glomerulosa. This misidentifies the producer of the hormone relevant to distal nephron sodium retention.
